name: 05 Sports Radar - Previews and start reminders

parameters.query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object('users',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(u),'[]'::jsonb)) AS context FROM (
 SELECT a.chat_id,a.previews_enabled,a.reminders_enabled,
 jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sport',f.sport,'team_key',f.team_key,'label',f.label,'aliases',f.aliases)) AS prefs
 FROM sports_radar.alert_preferences a JOIN sports_radar.follows f ON f.chat_id=a.chat_id
 WHERE a.previews_enabled OR a.reminders_enabled
 GROUP BY a.chat_id,a.previews_enabled,a.reminders_enabled
) u;

parameters.query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('jobs',COALESCE(jsonb_agg(j),'[]'::jsonb),'warnings',$2::jsonb) AS context FROM sports_radar.plan_alert_jobs($1::jsonb) j;

parameters.jsCode: const v=$input.first().json.context; const c=typeof v==='string'?JSON.parse(v):v; if(!c.jobs.length&&c.warnings.length)throw new Error(c.warnings.join(' ')); return c.jobs.map(json=>({json}));
const warnings=$('Build alert jobs').first().json.warnings; if(warnings.length)throw new Error('Available events were queued, but: '+warnings.join(' ')); return [{json:{planned:true}}];
